event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status; inferred from the paper and sample metadata that '1' = death, '0' = alive/censored at last follow-up, and '-' = missing

notes: The GSM metadata explicitly provide 'os time (months)' and 'OS status' for the renal cell carcinoma samples.
The paper defines OS as 'the time from surgery to the date of death.'

The numeric coding for 'OS status' is not explicitly decoded in the metadata or Methods; '1' was inferred to mean death because 10 tumor samples have value '1', matching the paper's statement that 10 patients died at the end of follow-up.
Value '-' appears in some tumor samples for 'os time (months)' and/or 'OS status', indicating missing survival metadata.
PFS is discussed in the paper for a treated subset, but no per-sample PFS variable is present in the GSM metadata, so it is not extracted as a dataset survival endpoint.
